name: BENCH: Command: Skeletal Warriors (504334) on a lone Lesser Skeletal Warrior kill, necromancer never swings
contract: SoloKill.RequirePlayerHit (#10365) gives an ungrouped player XP/loot only if they 'hit' the creature (Creature::AddDirectPlayerAttacker). Command orders go through Order() (AscensionNecromancerSummons.cpp:405) and may not register as a hit. This probes, on unfixed main, whether a creature killed solely by a Lesser Skeletal Warrior (50065, raised by Raise: Lesser Skeletal Warrior 500970, cost 1 Life Force) under Command: Skeletal Warriors 504334 gives the necromancer experience when the necromancer never swings or casts at the target.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and the Life Force aura settle
SETUP: the Lesser Skeletal Warrior is raised
Clear the global cooldown after summoning
Command: Skeletal Warriors on the target
SETUP: the Lesser Skeletal Warrior kills the target
BENCH: the necromancer gets experience from a Command kill it never swung at
The necromancer's level did not change
